scope: Fixed-threshold reference-dependent metrics, not clinical safety validation
bounds_interpretation: Ranges over unknown rule calls consistent with archived margins only; not confidence intervals, actual replay or a new algorithm.

ordering_certificate.scope: Ordering of continuous frozen ML scores versus the documented fixed binary rule score (0/1), under each common reference
ordering_certificate.bound_derivation: Rule has 308 fixed positive calls. October reference has 266 R and 259 S, so TP<=266 and FP>=42. Binary-score AUROC=(TPR+TNR)/2 <=(1+217/259)/2=0.9189189189. The complete feasible count enumeration also bounds binary-score AP at 266/308=0.8636363636.
ordering_certificate.limits: New rule point metrics and FN/FP are not recovered. Hard-decision BA/MCC/safety ordering is not certified. AP depends on reference prevalence. This is an established score-format identity applied to the documented comparator, not a new algorithm or clinical superiority claim.
